remarks: Furnished farmhouse with Waterviews and Walk to Train. Forget your cares and your car! Artist's restored farmhouse with oodles of charm, sophistication and amenities (central air, porch, swing, two patios, BBQ grill, grassy yards, outdoor Ping Pong, chef's kitchen and hydro tub for relaxing) in Westport's 'happening' restaurant village of Saugatuck. A 5-minute walk to everything: the train to NYC (one hour), kayak and paddle board rentals, ice cream, wine shops, dining. Across from a lovely riverside park with footpaths and nearby boardwalk. Stroll to library, Levitt Pavilion and bike to the beach and town golf, tennis, and sailing. What a location!
